# netbox_asn (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/ipam/#asn):
> ASN is short for Autonomous System Number. This identifier is used in the BGP protocol to identify which "autonomous system" a particular prefix is originating and transiting through.
>
> The AS number model within NetBox allows you to model some of this real-world relationship.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_rir" "test" {
  name = "testrir"
}

resource "netbox_asn" "test" {
  asn         = 1337
  rir_id      = netbox_rir.test.id
  description = "test"
  comments    = "test"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asn` (Number) Value for the AS Number record.
- `rir_id` (Number) ID for the RIR for the AS Number record.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments field for the AS Number record.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) Description field for the AS Number record.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the asn. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `role_id` (Number) The ID of the role associated with the asn. Needs NetBox 4.6.0 or later.
- `sites` (Set of Number) The IDs of the sites the AS number is assigned to. The sites can also list their AS numbers with `asn_ids`, so set the relation on one side only. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the asn.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_asn.example 1
```
